description: getaddrinfo must be exported for name resolution to be proxied
notes: Deterministic: needs neither network nor Tor. If this flips to VERIFIED the leak is fixed — update LIMITATIONS.md §1 and the make check assertion.

description: the connect() interposer must be exported or nothing is routed
notes: Baseline: without this the shim is inert and every row below is meaningless.

description: UDP payload must be routable (sendto/sendmsg exported), else UDP leaks
notes: Anonymity class: without a sendmsg/sendto hook UDP bytes go direct, never through Tor. The separate correctness class (udp-correctness) is socket corruption on connect().

description: no text relocations (required for full RELRO)
no unresolved symbols at load time
notes: A library that fails to load routes nothing.

description: public IPv4 connect must be intercepted by the shim

evidence.stderr: [TORX] routing connect() through Torconnect: Connection refused

notes: If this ever shows bypassed the shim is inert and no other dynamic row means anything.

description: loopback connections must never go through Tor
notes: Routing loopback would deadlock local services and Tor itself.

description: RFC1918 targets must bypass Tor (Tor cannot reach them)
AF_INET6 connect must be proxied or blocked, never passed through
notes: connect() passes sa_family != AF_INET straight to the real libc, so IPv6 egress exposes the origin address.

description: a -static binary must not silently lose interception
notes: Static binaries have no dynamic loader, so LD_PRELOAD is ignored entirely.

description: syscall(__NR_connect) must not bypass the interposer
notes: LD_PRELOAD interposes libc symbols, not syscalls. This is the adversary that motivates the netns architecture.

description: a SOCK_DGRAM connect() must not be converted into a Tor TCP connection

evidence.reroutes_note: times the shim printed the routing trace: 1 = initial connect only (post-ops skipped because the dead-port dial failed)

notes: Correctness class (socket corruption), not the anonymity class — that is udp.export.sendto. No SO_TYPE check exists anywhere in torx.c, so SOCKS4 (TCP-only) is attempted on a datagram socket; so_type here is still 2 only because the dead-port dial fails first — see udp.fd_swap for the live swap.

description: the application's UDP fd must not become a TCP socket (dup2 swap)

evidence.no_errno_note: send/sendto/reconnect all returned success after the swap — no errno is raised, so SO_TYPE is the only in-app tell

notes: The corruption in its final form: connect() returned success while the fd became SOCK_STREAM — the app's datagram payload now rides a TCP stream, send()/sendto() still report success (address silently ignored), and a second connect() routes a fresh Tor stream over the same fd (reroutes=2). Correctness class, distinct from the udp leak class. Needs a live Tor, hence not a gate.

description: DNS queries must not egress outside Tor

evidence.reason: observing DNS egress needs CAP_NET_RAW (tcpdump) or a controlled resolver

notes: dns.export.getaddrinfo (static) is the CI gate for this class; this row documents why a dynamic gate is not yet possible.

description: end-to-end egress via a real Tor circuit
notes: Run against a live Tor; excluded from CI gates (timing-dependent).
